name: Wallfahrtskirche Maria Thal
kurzbeschreibung: The baroque pilgrimage church Wallfahrtskirche Maria Thal near Kufstein enchants at the forest edge with a late Gothic miraculous image, ex-voto tablets, and profound peace.
beschreibung:
Overview

The idyllically situated Wallfahrtskirche Maria Thal (also known as Wallfahrtskirche Thal am Thiersee) nestles against a gentle forest slope at around 700 metres above sea level near the fortress town of Kufstein and the Passion Play village of Thiersee. Embedded in lush alpine meadows and shaded mixed forests against the steep limestone walls of the Kaisergebirge and the Thierseetal, this small Marian sanctuary has been an oasis of silence, prayer, and contemplation for pilgrims and hikers from Tyrol and Bavaria for centuries.

History & Miraculous Image

The pilgrimage tradition in Thal dates back to the late 15th century. According to tradition, a wooden wayside shrine originally stood on this site, where shepherds and travellers prayed for protection against storms and hardship. Following reports of answered prayers and miraculous healings, a first Gothic chapel was built around 1500. The church owes its present appearance to a baroque rebuilding and expansion in the 17th and early 18th centuries, when the flow of pilgrims reached its peak. The sacred centrepiece is the late Gothic miraculous image Unsere Liebe Frau von Thal – an artfully carved Madonna and Child from the early 16th century, flanked by baroque putti on the gilded altar. Numerous historic ex-voto tablets on the church walls bear impressive witness to the deep popular piety and gratitude of people from past eras for deliverance from illness, the dangers of war, and rural distress.

Visit & Getting There

The Wallfahrtskirche Maria Thal is open all year round during the day for visitors and worshippers with free admission (open daily from approx. 08:00 to 18:00). Festive pilgrim masses are celebrated on Marian feast days and Sundays. Arrival by public transport: By train to Kufstein international railway station, from there regional bus line 4046 runs regularly towards Thiersee to the bus stop Thal; from there it is just a few minutes' walk to the church. By car: From the Inntal motorway A12, exit Kufstein Nord, follow Thierseestraße L37 uphill for a few kilometres towards Thiersee, then follow the signs to Thal; parking is available directly below the church hill.

Tips

Access to the church is largely step-free and easily manageable for pushchairs and wheelchair users with minimal assistance. The peaceful bench beneath the old linden trees in front of the church portal offers a picturesque resting spot after a circular walk around nearby Thiersee lake or a stroll along the Kufstein forest nature trail. Visit the church in the late afternoon when the warm sunlight streams through the church windows.
